identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Surufatinib Combined With Sintilimab and SCRT in Advanced Solid Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Exploratory Clinical Study of Short Course Radiotherapy Combined With Surufatinib and Sintilimab in the Treatment of Relapsed and Refractory Advanced Solid Tumors

leadSponsor.name: Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology

descriptionModule.briefSummary: An exploratory clinical study of short course radiotherapy combined with surufatinib and sintilimab in the treatment of relapsed and refractory advanced solid tumors

conditions: Biliary Tract Tumors, Gastric Cancer, Small Cell Lung Cancer

armGroups.label: Surufatinib Combined With Sintilimab and SCRT

interventions.name: Surufatinib
interventions.description: Surufatinib 250mg will be taken orally once daily continuously on a 21-day cycle
armGroupLabels: Surufatinib Combined With Sintilimab and SCRT

interventions.name: Sintilimab
interventions.description: Sintilimab 200mg will be intravenously administered on Day 1 of each cycle
armGroupLabels: Surufatinib Combined With Sintilimab and SCRT

interventions.name: Short course radiotherapy
interventions.description: 5Gy\*5F short course radiotherapy will be delivered
armGroupLabels: Surufatinib Combined With Sintilimab and SCRT
